==Summary==
:{{pov|[[Moiraine Damodred]]}}

[[Moiraine]] has been riding for approximately three months. Her skin still feels too tight from the [[Three Oaths]]. The latest news from [[Cairhien]] is that four [[House]]s are vying for the [[Sun Throne]]. She is wearing her ''[[kesiera]]'' and one of her newly-tailored riding dresses. The new [[Aes Sedai]] has been traveling as [[Alys]], a minor [[Cairhienin]] noble. She is currently in [[Canluum]] interviewing Jurin Najima and her daughters Colar and Eselle. Her husband Josef, baby Jerid, and their other sons were killed in a mysterious fire. Jurin claims that her husband was always lucky. He went to fight the [[Aiel]] at Lady Kareil's request. Moiraine learns that Jerid was born in the wrong place to be the [[Dragon Reborn]] and quickly loses interest. She has scratched off many names in her booklet, but hundreds remain.

Moiraine returns to her inn, the [[Gates of Heaven]]. Five sisters, including one [[Red Ajah|Red]], are staying at the same inn. At the inn, Moiraine runs into [[Larelle Tarsi]] and [[Merean Redhill]], who can now leave the Tower as she is no longer [[Mistress of Novices]]. As Moiraine is trying to figure out how to evade them, [[Felaana Bevaine]] interrupts. Felaana is a [[Brown Ajah|Brown sister]] who does not know Moiraine and thinks Moiraine is a wilder. Because Moiraine has [[Slowing|slowed]] but does not yet have the ageless face, Felaana thinks Moiraine is younger than she is, perhaps close to eighteen. Larelle and Merean decide not to dispel the misunderstanding and are willing to let Moiraine go, but then [[Cadsuane Melaidhrin]] appears and demands to speak to them.

Moiraine met the legendary Aes Sedai two years back, when the elderly Aes Sedai came out of retirement during the [[Aiel War]]. Rumor has it that Cadsuane kidnapped a [[Tarabon]] king who could [[channel]], kidnapped the King of [[Arad Doman]] and the Queen of [[Saldaea]] to stop a war, and even assaulted an [[Amyrlin Seat|Amyrlin]]. Cadsuane prods Moiraine, Larelle and Merean to a private room where she questions Moiraine about being incognito. Cadsuane defies custom and asks Moiraine directly what she is doing in the [[Borderlands]], and Moiraine implies that she is there to find a [[Warder]]. Then Cadsuane asks Larelle and Merean about her. They embarrass Moiraine, even telling Cadsuane that she and [[Siuan]] were caught with mice for [[Elaida]]'s bed right before they were to be raised. Moiraine makes to leave, saying that she is going to [[Chachin]] and immediately realizes she should not have disclosed that. Her next targets are [[Avene Sahera]] in a village on the way and Lady [[Ines Demain]] in Chachin. Cadsuane then brings up age (the first rudeness), shocking the other Aes Sedai. She speaks of the Tower's problem of dwindling numbers, and how the strongest Aes Sedai such as herself will soon die off and ones like Moiraine will be the strongest of those who remain. Then she says that Larelle and Merean should go with Moiraine to Chachin to look after the young Aes Sedai until she finds a Warder, as the Tower cannot afford to lose her. The older Aes Sedai and Moiraine protest vehemently and fruitlessly. Cadsuane tells Moiraine that she will check tonight to make sure that Moiraine does not leave without the others.

==Notes==
*The "mysterious fire" was caused by members of the [[Black Ajah]]. As it is revealed at the end of [[New Spring]], the Black did sloppy work trying to find the [[Dragon Reborn]]. They knew he would be ''[[ta'veren]]'', so they just killed men who had been unusually lucky several times in their lives.
